subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should this PR land as a scoped embedded `sessions_spawn` mitigation while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92271 tracks the remaining gateway, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native spawn surfaces, or should it wait for one shared work-spawning policy seam?
rationale: The patch changes fallback-turn delegation policy and deliberately leaves related delegation surfaces uncovered, so automation cannot choose the fail-closed boundary or cross-repo Codex scope.

options.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
options.body: After the merge conflict is refreshed, land the embedded guard and keep the related issue open for explicitly owned follow-ups.

options.title: Harden Shared Policy First
options.body: Require the PR to cover a common OpenClaw work-spawning policy seam before merge so gateway and `sessions_send` style delegation are handled together.

options.title: Pause For Codex Scope
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether Codex-native `spawn_agent` must be part of the same fix or an upstream follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: After the merge conflict is refreshed, land the embedded guard and keep the related issue open for explicitly owned follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` is assigned and authored the cross-harness scope review that frames this maintainer choice.
